description: This Java class 'UtilCache' provides a generalized caching utility with features like size limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. It manages cache instances, tracks hits/misses, and supports cache operations such as put, get, remove, and clear.

classes.name: UtilCache
classes.description: A thread-safe, serializable cache utility supporting size limits, expiration, soft references, and event listeners. Manages cache instances and provides core cache operations.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Insert or update an element in the cache with optional expiration time.

methods.name: putIfAbsent
methods.description: Insert an element only if it is not already present in the cache.

methods.name: putIfAbsentAndGet
methods.description: Insert an element if absent and return the existing or new value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove an element from the cache by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear all entries from the cache.

methods.name: setMaxInMemory
methods.description: Set the maximum in-memory size of the cache.

methods.name: setExpireTime
methods.description: Set expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: setUseSoftReference
methods.description: Configure whether cache entries use soft references.
